method_limitations: Correlation is evidence of repeated timing, not proof that one gauge caused or uniquely predicts the other.
Shared rainfall, tributary inflow, regulation, telemetry gaps, and changing flood-wave speed can shift or mimic a lag.
A passing quality result still requires river-topology review and never changes a locality mapping or official severity.
